title: Needletail strict configuration (M1-A, version 1)
description: Informative editor schema only. The Swift codec (bounded duplicate preflight plus strict typed validation) is the normative validator; it additionally rejects duplicate keys at every level, enforces byte bounds, and freezes unknown-field and reserved-key rules. No YAML, templating, or executable configuration.

version.description: Configuration format version. Exactly 1; newer versions fail closed.

default_model.description: Alias of the default profile; must reference models[].alias.

items.description: Origin only: scheme://host[:port]. No path, credentials, query or fragment.

base_url.description: scheme://host[:port] plus an optional explicit path prefix such as /v1. No credentials, query, fragment, traversal or double suffix.

model.description: Opaque served model ID. Strings only: numeric-looking IDs are never coerced.

credential.description: Exactly one reference kind: variable name, 0600 file path, or keychain account. Never a secret value.

request_options.description: Inert operator-owned native JSON (max 64 KiB serialized). Reserved harness-owned keys are rejected; other keys are unqualified until exercised.

exec.description: true, false, or ask. Absent means denied.
